project.name: clear-text-utilities
project.summary: A curated helper-library miniature without a fabricated lifecycle.
project.thesis: A small public function family applies documented transformations without claiming a lifecycle.

nodes.label: Public Functions
nodes.description: Exposes slugify and wrap_label as independent public text helpers.
nodes.why_it_matters: These helpers are the library surface a caller chooses.
nodes.inspector_summary: Two independent exported helper functions define the public surface.

nodes.label: Option Schema
nodes.description: Defines separator and width options shared by helper calls.
nodes.why_it_matters: It describes variation without imposing call order.
nodes.inspector_summary: FormatOptions is a declarative public contract.

nodes.label: Transformation Rules
nodes.description: Applies independent string formatting rules within each helper.
nodes.inspector_summary: Rules are per-call logic, not lifecycle stages.

nodes.label: Usage Examples
nodes.description: Shows representative independent calls without defining a temporal path.
nodes.inspector_summary: Examples help readers choose helpers but do not claim workflow.

workflows.label: API Reading Route
workflows.description: Read available helper surfaces without implying execution order.

atlas.scenario_policy_reason: The library exposes independent helper calls; an ordered playback would invent a lifecycle.

decision_record.repository_thesis_summary: A small public function family applies documented transformations without claiming a lifecycle.

projection_candidates.label: API Reading Route
projection_candidates.question_answered: What should a caller understand before choosing a helper?
projection_candidates.selection_reason: It preserves the independent nature of the public functions.

projection_candidates.label: Execution Loop
projection_candidates.question_answered: How do helpers progress through a lifecycle?
distortion_risks: The library has no such lifecycle.
projection_candidates.selection_reason: A lifecycle projection would be invented.

scenario_candidates.label: No Ordered Playback
scenario_candidates.reason: A scenario is unnecessary for independent calls.
